summary: RTB Digital filed an 8-K disclosing a September 16-22, 2026 private placement of 494,159 restricted common shares at $11.13 per share for $5,500,000 gross proceeds, alongside $5,500,000 of 20% secured loans to unnamed borrowers. Purchasers include founder- and principal-stockholder-affiliated investors; no broker-dealer was engaged. Shares carry registration rights (piggyback plus one-time demand exercisable after 180 days) and release from lock-up in four equal tranches from May 2027 through February 2028. The filing is chiefly a financing event rather than a special situation, though the insider participation, equity-collateralized lending and four-tranche overhang are notable.
